title: Add the documentation specialist profile so opum-workflow documenter can compile its context pack (OPAG-688)
description: Filed on opum-agent's dispatch (OPAG-688, 2026-09-28). origin/dev carries only three .lore/agents/ profiles (implementation, review, verification): OPAG-33 left the fourth out for uniformity, OPAG-417 has since given all four to five more repositories, so uniformity now means four. The opum-workflow documenter specialist compiles its pack from the 'documentation' profile, so it cannot dispatch in this repository until this file exists. The ruling and its measurement live on opum-ai/opum-agent's OPAG-688.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `.lore/agents/documentation.toml` lands on dev, sized like OPAG-33's lore-cli pack budgets (implementation 20000, review 18000, verification 16000)

`lore agent context documentation --task "<something real>"` is captured BEFORE and AFTER the file lands; after, stderr carries no `warning: agent profile "documentation" was not found` AND the pack's catalog comes from the profile's sources ("exits 0 with a non-empty pack" alone is NOT the proof: without a profile lore 0.11.0 exits 0 with the degraded pack, LCLI-575)
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0

plan: 1. Verify the candidate source list against the committed bundle (lore read per id) and confirm none is a heading of another (the runbook forbids listing a whole concept and one of its headings).
2. Write .lore/agents/documentation.toml with a candidate budget, matching the sibling profiles shape (schema_version 1, kind specialist, pinned ["index"]).

3. SWEEP max_tokens across a range against a real documentation task; read the allowed-source catalog at each step for the omission curve (OPAG-33 method: no source scoring >=9 may be fully omitted). Set max_tokens where the curve flattens.
4. Re-take the BEFORE capture if /tmp is gone; capture AFTER at the chosen budget and assert the warning is ABSENT and the catalog is drawn from the profile sources.
5. Gates: bun test and bun run lore check exit 0 (run solo; disk is tight).
6. Record evidence on the task, open the PR, land on dev.
implementationNotes: OPAG-688 corrected AC (orchestrator, 2026-09-28): mere exit-0-with-non-empty-pack is the degraded pack and would certify a missing profile; require the no-warning + catalog-source pair, captured before and after.
Filed at the orchestrator's request to move the record up; the implementation still waits for the 632/634-639 campaign boundary.

LCLI-640 IMPLEMENTED on branch feat/LCLI-640-documentation-profile. .lore/agents/documentation.toml added: budget 20000, pinned ["index"], 10 sources.

SHAPE, taken from precedent read BY REF rather than described. All four sibling documentation profiles now exist (opum-agent, opum-doc, quest-cli, opum-cli-e2e), each read at its own origin/dev with git ls-tree / git show, never from a working tree: schema_version 1, kind "specialist", pinned = ["index"], and a description naming the bundle entry point and what the sources are authoritative for. Siblings sit at 8000-12000; this bundle is four times opum-doc's, so the budget is measured here, not copied.

BUDGET BY SWEEP, OPAG-33's method read from opum-agent's own completed OPAG-33 at origin/dev: compile the pack at each budget, read the allowed-source catalog, and apply the test "no source whose top relevance score is 9 or above may be fully omitted".

MEASURED across four realistic documentation tasks. T1 "Document the tagged-commit release-notes rule in the release runbook" (the BEFORE/AFTER task), T2 "Write the reference page explaining who owns which documentation in this repository", T3 "Author a runbook section on operating an autonomous documentation campaign here", T4 "Update the documentation index to link the new agent profile records". Columns are fully-omitted source counts.

  8000     8  6  6  5    25    11.682614

20000 has both the minimum total omissions and the minimum worst-omitted score. Every budget from 16000 up satisfies OPAG-33's >=9 test; 8000 and 12000 do NOT, because a source scoring 11.682614 is fully omitted at 8000.

FINDING, and it makes the usual reading of "sweep until the curve flattens" unsafe: THE OMISSION CURVE IS NOT MONOTONE IN BUDGET, so a LARGER budget can yield a strictly WORSE pack. At 20000 the T1 pack holds 23 of 80 ranked blocks (80278 bytes); at 20500 it holds 5 of 80 (82268 bytes) -- 2000 bytes larger and 18 blocks poorer. Mechanism, read off the packs rather than inferred: context "ranks complete heading/top-level-block records" (docs/reference/cli-surface.md), so when the budget grows enough for one large high-scoring block to be admitted whole it consumes the room several smaller blocks were using. Measured at 20500: "Release publishing > Steps > 3. Cut a release" enters at score 8.480238 and the selection collapses from 23 blocks to 5. The budget is documented as a CEILING (docs/reference/cli-contract.md: "a supplied budget is a ceiling the emitted pack never [exceeds]"), so this is contract-compliant and NOT a contract violation -- but it means a budget sweep must be read as a table rather than as a curve that converges, and 20000 is a measured LOCAL OPTIMUM, not a plateau: 19500 and 20500 are both worse. Flagged to opum-agent as a possible design question rather than absorbed into this repository's backlog.

SOURCE SET, each id verified present with `lore read` before it was written, and each shown to earn its place. Inclusion across the four tasks at 20000 (FULL = every section of the source selected, part = some, OMIT = none):

T1 is the release-notes task, which runbooks/release-publishing correctly dominates; every source T1 omits is selected for T2-T4. That is OPAG-33's "a source omitted for one task is included for another" as a measurement rather than an assurance. No concept is listed both whole and by heading, which the agent-profile runbook forbids.

BEFORE / AFTER. A MATCHED PAIR taken minutes apart in this checkout with the same binary, corroborated by the original capture the previous session preserved, so the AFTER is not measured against a stale artifact.
  BEFORE re-taken 2026-09-29 (profile moved aside, same task): exit 0; stderr `warning: agent profile "documentation" was not found (.lore/agents/documentation.toml); this pack carries only the bundle-wide query hits -- add the profile or run \`lore agent list\``; stdout 1710 bytes; profile line `Profile: no agent profile named "documentation"; bundle-wide query hits only`; catalog `_None._`.
  BEFORE preserved 2026-09-28T23:27 at /tmp/lcli640-before/: byte-for-byte the same warning and profile line, 1710 bytes. The two BEFORE captures agree.
  AFTER: exit 0; stderr EMPTY, the warning ABSENT; stdout 80278 bytes; profile line carries the profile's own description; catalog lists all 11 entries -- index (pinned) plus the 10 sources -- each with its selected/total and reason.
AC2 is satisfied on its own measurement and not on exit-0-with-a-non-empty-pack: the LCLI-575 degraded pack also exits 0, and it is precisely the BEFORE column above.

GATES, run SOLO, with versions named. bun test exit 0: 4799 pass, 1 skip, 0 fail, 19723 expect() calls, 4800 tests across 133 files, 257.22s. bun run lore check exit 0: "82 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 9 out-of-bundle links skipped", from source via `bun run lore`, never the globally installed binary. bun 1.3.14, node v24.20.0, lore 0.11.0 (src/cli.ts), quest 0.11.0. `lore agent list` reports 4 profiles; `lore agent show documentation` reports budget 20000, pinned index, 10 sources, delegates none.

DISK. The machine's data volume sat at 98% / 4.2 GiB free during this work. All scratch was kept under /tmp (sweep packs, logs), the checkout's scratchpad/ is empty, and the two heavy gates were run one at a time rather than concurrently. Full CI verification is preferred for any further iteration on this branch; local `bun test` was run once because AC3 names the command.
